issues.description: Attribute Course.instructor has conflicting types across artifacts. The problem statement (and the template) specify Course.instructor as a String (e.g. initializer hint Course(name: "My Course", instructor: "My Instructor", ratings: [])), while the solution implementation declares Course.instructor as [String] (an array). The solution's Client also constructs a Course using a String for the instructor argument, which is inconsistent with the solution Course initializer that expects [String]. This type mismatch will cause compilation failures and confuses students about whether to implement instructor as a single String or an array.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Course.instructor type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the solution to match the problem statement and template by declaring instructor as String and updating the Course initializer to accept a String. Update any solution code that treats instructor as an array (for example the property declaration and any uses) to use a single String. Alternatively, if multiple instructors were intended, update the problem statement, template, and all examples (including Client) to document and pass [String] consistently — but choose one representation and apply it everywhere.
